function.name: list_data
function.description: Browse cached connected-source catalogs. With no arguments, list source summaries. With source_id, list its top-level entries. Add path to browse direct children and filter for a case-insensitive substring match.

source_id.description: Connected source identifier. Omit for source summaries.

function.name: find_data
function.description: Regex search across cached connected-source catalogs and optionally existing workspace tables. Returns exact source_id and table_key values for follow-up inspection.

query.description: Case-insensitive regex. Plain keywords work as literals.

scope.description: all, workspace, connected, a source_id, or source_id:path/segments.

fields.description: Fields to search. Omit for all.

function.name: describe_data
function.description: Read cached metadata, columns, types, description, and row count for one discovered table.

function.name: probe_data
function.description: Run a bounded read-only structured query against one connected table. Use only after describe_data. Results are evidence for planning and do not become workspace inputs.

function.name: list_connectors
function.description: List connector types available in this deployment. Call this before propose_connection because built-ins, plugins, and missing dependencies vary by deployment. If the user's requested type is present, you MUST call propose_connection in the same turn; do not merely say you will open a form.

function.name: describe_connector
function.description: Return setup fields and authentication choices for one source_type returned by list_connectors. After this, call propose_connection in the same turn; describing fields does not open the form.

source_type.description: Connector type key returned by list_connectors.

function.name: propose_connection
function.description: REQUIRED terminal action when the user wants an available connector and its source_type is known. This is the only operation that opens the user-confirmed add-connector form on the canvas. Call list_connectors first. Prefill only values the user supplied; never invent credentials or connect automatically.

source_type.description: Connector type key returned by list_connectors.

prefilled.description: Optional connector field values already supplied by the user. Values seed the live form and must not be repeated in prose.

function.name: propose_data_operation
function.description: Offer one to three complete immutable connected-data loading alternatives and pause for the user's selection. Discovery must ground every source, table, filter, and sort field. This does not execute a load.

response.description: Fallback only. Leave empty when you narrate in your message text, which is what the user reads.

query.description: Optional raw-row subset. Omit to load the whole table subject to server limits.
